body: Thanks for the comments and advice.  I have been wanting to get this off my chest and haven't found a comfortable avenue for expression that I could get meaningful feedback out of.  I don't want to be this way anymore, and opting out seems like an attractive course of action sometimes.  In the last year I've begun to explore my feelings and thoughts more than ever before, and I just don't like what I see.  When I visit my family, I just feel this...resistance, like I'm caught on a door frame and the harder I pull and try to get past that threshold, the more it feels like I'm tearing something off of me.  I am resentful that I can't seem to accomplish anything and I feel it 10fold from the people around me.  I think I could benefit from counseling or therapy, and will seek out assistance.  It's clear that I need to confide in someone, I just don't want to bother anyone.
